map.：涂片阳性且有传染；Xpert 报利福平耐药→RR-TB，按耐药流程隔离治疗。: : a positive smear means it is infectious; Xpert reporting rifampicin resistance means RR-TB, so isolate and treat per the drug-resistant protocol.
map.：涂片阴性+培养阴性→传染性低，仍完成疗程并复查。: : smear negative plus culture negative means low transmissibility, but the full course should still be completed and rechecked.
